operation.summary: Send a message, data and optionally a kept photo to one of the owner's connections. Queued and retried by default; wait_reply waits up to 15 s and returns the reply

body.name: data
body.description: Up to 32 keys of text, numbers or true/false (16 KiB). Bridgit adds applet, flow, run_id, sent_at and phone

body.name: text
body.description: A short line, up to 1000 characters. Needed for Discord, Slack, Telegram, ntfy and Pushover

body.name: photo
body.description: A kept photo of your applet (kept:…), for connections that take photos

body.name: wait_reply
body.description: true sends now and waits up to 15 s for the reply

operation.example: POST /v1/connections/send {"to":"<connection id>","text":"A package is at the front door","data":{"where":"front door"}}
operation.returns: queued true and delivery_id; or with wait_reply: status (HTTP), reply (JSON) or reply_text, queued false

wait_reply.description: true sends now and waits up to 15 s for the reply

data.description: Up to 32 keys of text, numbers or true/false (16 KiB). Bridgit adds applet, flow, run_id, sent_at and phone

photo.description: A kept photo of your applet (kept:…), for connections that take photos

text.description: A short line, up to 1000 characters. Needed for Discord, Slack, Telegram, ntfy and Pushover
